title: BDP Callables version 1 structural projections
$comment: Feature-owned supplement to unchanged BDP v0.1. Shape validation does not establish support, authorization or implementation conformance.

callablesCapabilityV1.description: Version-1 detail of the Callables capability: the one navigation member a client follows to learn what is invocable.

directory.description: Absolute HTTP(S) URL of the callable directory served for this Scope.

callablesDiscovery.description: A Core or Write discovery document that advertises Callables version 1 with its closed detail.

callableDirectoryEntry.description: One invocable name's binding: the exact definition revision it is bound to and the mount that invokes it.

definition.description: Pinned Reference to the exact definition revision the name is bound to.

invoke.description: Absolute HTTP(S) mount URL that invokes the Callable.

callableDirectory.description: The authority for what is invocable in a Scope: a closed map from invocable name to its binding. An empty map means nothing is invocable.

callables.description: Map from name, one nonempty safe segment compared exactly, to its directory entry.

callableInvocation.description: The closed invocation body. The mount supplies the operation; no operation, name or key member rides in the body.

arguments.description: Object keyed by parameter name; an empty object when the definition declares no parameters.

definition.description: The definition revision the client parsed; a mismatch with the directory's binding is callable-revision-mismatch.

revisionProvenance.description: Write's attribution input, admitted on a CallableBatch invocation and carried onto every revision the batch commits; refused on a CallableQuery.

callableResult.description: The closed success body of an invocation: the exact definition revision executed, the result value, and for a CallableBatch whether anything committed.

callable.description: Pinned Reference to the exact definition revision executed.

changed.description: CallableBatch only, then required: true when the batch committed any Resource, alias or retained-state effect, else false.

result.description: Any JSON value, valid against the definition's result schema when one is declared.

callableProblemMembers.description: The members of a Problem whose code this profile adds. Core's and Write's codes keep their own shapes; an invocation Problem is one or the other.

code.description: One of the four codes this profile adds.

reason.description: Required with callable-refused: the implementation's nonempty refusal token, compared exactly.

retry.description: Always after-state-change for these four codes.

callableProblem.description: A Problem answered by the directory or a mount: a Core or Write Problem, or one carrying a code this profile adds.
